qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A substantial softly lit blue wreck frame with crafted dark iron/pale hardware, a purposeful exposed broken-sheet edge identity and clean native joins to the exact approved middle02 in all four facings.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Hull sections, iron bracing and the edge-specific exposed sheet read as substantial constructed volumes with soft rounded or faceted edges. Useful improvements in native forms, proportions and construction are welcome; source boxes and counts are not locks.

Readable blue/cyan hull midtones, darker slate iron and pale fasteners remain distinct. Warm cream wear is restrained and purposeful, avoiding yellow stripe dominance or featureless black sheet/hardware surfaces.

Broad gentle highlights and value transitions describe volume in every facing, with controlled material reflection, balanced horizontal illumination and no directional ground cast shadow, glare or glowing fringe.

Purposeful worn edges, shallow grain, chips, fasteners or small construction details give the hull age and character without noisy microtexture or clutter. Native design may improve beyond the fixed target where function and palette remain clear.

At logical128, the hull construction and exposed edge variant are immediately legible; at phone32 its blue/metal hierarchy and edge identity survive. All four views form one coherent native object. Legitimate open rail/bay space remains readable rather than muddy or accidentally punctured.

Both actual W/E connections to the approved middle02 look continuous in native mixed assembly and independently composed current-consumer sprites at all4 facings/light-gray-dark/logical128/phone32. Reject local cracks, slits, contrasting stripes, steps, doubled caps, halos, black patches, clipping or abrupt material/normal response. Numeric equality cannot waive a visible local defect.
